title: Warriors of Past Epoch - Iron Recipes Addon
description: Replaces Forgotten Steel with vanilla iron in crafting recipes for Warriors of Past Epoch.
body:
Warriors of Past Epoch - Iron Addon

This addon changes the progression of Warriors of Past Epoch by replacing Forgotten Steel with vanilla Minecraft iron.

Changes:

Replaces Forgotten Steel with vanilla iron in crafting recipes.
Forgotten Steel Nuggets are replaced with Iron Nuggets.
Forgotten Steel Ingots are replaced with Iron Ingots.
Removes Forgotten Steel ore from world generation.
Replaces Forgotten Steel in chest loot with vanilla iron.
Replaces Forgotten Steel drops from mobs with vanilla iron.
Skeleton Musketeers can drop Iron Nuggets instead of Forgotten Steel Nuggets.
Keeps the other original loot, including Azure Fabric, Gunpowder, Bones, and the Musket.

Requirements:

Minecraft 1.20.1
Forge
Warriors of Past Epoch
GeckoLib

This is an addon and does not include the original Warriors of Past Epoch mod. The original mod must be installed separately.
